instagram.caption:
$15M later, Passionfroot is taking its B2B creator marketplace to the US—after European creators rejected fixed pricing. 🇺🇸

The startup flipped its model: instead of demanding fixed rates, it now offers flexible deal terms. US buyers can choose how much to pay per collaboration. No more middlemen.

For B2B content creators, this means you set your own price per brand deal, not the platform.

Got a past campaign result that would land you a better rate? What's stopping you from pitching it?
